namingConventions.apiRoutes: REST-style route handlers under app/api/<resource>/route.ts with kebab-free, lowercase segment naming.
namingConventions.components: PascalCase component files under /components with one primary component export per file.
namingConventions.prismaModels: PascalCase singular model names (User, Word, Progress) with camelCase scalar fields and explicit relation names where needed.

relations: User belongs to native and target Language.
Language has many Word and Sentence records.
Word and Sentence have many-to-many via WordSentence.
User + Word map to Progress (unique userId_wordId).
NextAuth models Account/Session/VerificationToken integrate authentication persistence.

authFlowDescription.registration: POST /api/auth/register hashes password with bcryptjs and stores user with selected languages.
authFlowDescription.login: Credentials authorize() loads user by email and compares passwordHash.
authFlowDescription.session: JWT strategy stores user id, admin role, native/target language IDs in token and session callbacks.
authFlowDescription.protection: Middleware protects /dashboard, /learn, /test, /library and checks admin token for /admin.

expansionPoints.newTestTypes: Add new generator/submit strategy branches in app/api/tests/* and corresponding reusable components.
expansionPoints.aiGeneration: Introduce modular services in /lib (e.g. lib/ai.ts) to generate words/sentences and write through Prisma models.
expansionPoints.customWordLists: Add list/listItem models and list-scoped fetching in /api/words and /learn selection logic.
expansionPoints.spacedRepetition: Extend Progress with interval/ease fields and replace sort logic in lib/learning.ts with SRS scheduling.
expansionPoints.adminConfigurableTests: Add TestConfig model and use it in /api/tests/generate for adaptive settings.
